programs.title: Lost Cities With Albert Lin
programs.sub_title: In the footsteps of the Templars
programs.desc: Fans of the adventures of Indiana Jones have the opportunity to see that reality is not inferior to film fiction, and scientists are constantly revising their knowledge about the past.The fabulous treasures of the Templars, the lost gold of El Dorado, the ruins of a city called the Venice of the Pacific, the holy places of the Incas and the mystery of Stonehenge - these are selected points on the map of Albert Lin's documentary journey.The scientist uses advanced technologies and various gadgets to see what was previously hidden from the eyes of archaeologists and historians.The legendary treasure of the order The exciting expedition begins in Acre in Israel - a strategic port city whose history dates back to the Bronze Age.A modern adventurer is looking for traces of the legendary Templar kingdom and its valuables.In the basement of a historic church, he meets Dr. Eliezer Stern, who is his guide to the heritage of brave knights from the 12th and 13th centuries.One can see what a brilliant engineering achievement the crypts equipped with huge water reservoirs were.While looking for gold that the monks obtained from pilgrims, he reaches a tunnel connecting the port with other districts of the city.Thanks to advanced technologies, it creates a map.Will it lead him to the treasure?
